;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 in Malaysia#September|2017 disasters in Malaysia]]
**A fire at an [[Islamic]] [[boarding school]] for boys kills 24 people, most of them students, in [[Kuala Lumpur]], [[Malaysia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-fire/blaze-kills-24-at-islamic-school-in-malaysian-capital-idUSKCN1BP04T (Reuters)]
*[[2017 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Flights are cancelled and evacuations are ordered for over 100,000 people in the [[North Central Coast]] of [[Vietnam]], in preparation for [[Typhoon]] Doksuri. The system has already claimed four lives passing over the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/vietnam-braces-for-storm-doksuri-ordering-evacuation/2017/09/14/f12d7564-9920-11e7-af6a-6555caaeb8dc_story.html  (''The Washington Post'')]

;International relations
*[[Zapad 2017 exercise]], [[Belarus–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] begin a six-day joint strategic [[military exercise]] inside Belarus and Russia's [[Kaliningrad Oblast]]. The military exercise simulates war against the fictional state of [[Veyshnoria]]. According to the [[Defence Ministry of Belarus]], fewer than 13,000 personnel will be taking part in the exercise; however, Western analysts believe the total number will range from 60,000 to 100,000. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-nato/russias-zapad-war-games-unnerve-the-west-idUSKCN1BO1OG (Reuters)]
*[[India–Japan relations]]
**[[Japan]] agrees to help with the construction of an [[India]]n [[High-speed rail|bullet train]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/sep/14/india-starts-work-on-its-first-bullet-train-line (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[California]] wants to schedule its [[Primary elections in the United States|primaries]] earlier than usual, possibly on March or [[Super Tuesday]], to have much more influence in comparison to its weight and diversity and to help Californian candidates, such as [[Eric Garcetti]] and [[Kamala Harris]]. **The [[International Union for Conservation of Nature]] upgrades the [[conservation status]] of the [[snow leopard]] from endangered to vulnerable. [http://news.sky.com/story/snow-leopard-taken-off-endangered-list-but-still-vulnerable-11035447 (Sky News)]

;Sports
*[[2017 Major League Baseball season]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[Cleveland Indians]] break the [[Major League Baseball]] record for longest [[List of Major League Baseball longest winning streaks|winning streak]] with 22 wins in a row. The 1935 [[Chicago Cubs]] previously held the record with 21.
